newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTORCYCLING-APRILIA PART WITH 250 CHAMPION BIAGGI.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-APRILIA PART WITH 250 CHAMPION BIAGGI.

text.p: Italian motorcycle manufacturer Aprilia said on Tuesday they had parted with triple 250cc world champion Max Biaggi.

Aprilia said in a statement that they would have three 250cc works riders next season -- Italian Stefano Perugini who moves up from the 125cc class, compatriot Loris Capirossi who comes down from 500cc racing and Japan's Tetsuya Harada.
The manufacturer said Capirossi, a former 125cc champion who won one 500cc Grand Prix with Yamaha last season, was expected to finalise a three-year contract in the next few days.
"A similar agreement was not feasible with Biaggi," it said, thanking the Roman rider for his past efforts.
Italian newspapers have reported that Honda wanted Biaggi, who has also hinted heavily that he wants to move up to 500cc racing, for another go at the 250cc title.
